_status: DORMANT by owner request (2026-08-31). The manifest offers NO update, so no on-prem agent will EVER self-update until this is deliberately re-armed. The v3.3 print-agent code + server endpoints stay in place but do nothing.

_to_activate_3_3_0.how: Copy these into the top-level latest/sha256/url (or set AGENT_LATEST_VERSION / AGENT_SHA256 / AGENT_DOWNLOAD_URL on the VPS) AND host the .exe at that url. To ship a NEWER build later: bump AGENT_VERSION in agent.mjs + version in package.json, run npm run build:exe, host the exe, and put the new version + its sha256sum here.
